issue.title: Adding a recipient moved our weekly export from Monday to Thursday
issue.body:
Our weekly "AP aging" export has always arrived on Monday mornings. Last
Thursday I added a colleague to its recipients with `PATCH /reports/:id`,
sending the same `schedule` with one more address. No email came on Monday, and
the report's `nextRunAt` now says Thursday 06:00 UTC. Only the recipients
changed: same cadence, same format.

input.title: Keep a report's next run when a PATCH resends an unchanged schedule
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

In the PATCH /reports/:id handler, nextRun is recomputed by firstRunAt(patch.schedule) whenever the request includes a schedule, even when only the recipients changed. That restarts the cadence from the time of the PATCH, so a weekly Monday export moves to whatever day the edit happened. Proposed change: when patch.schedule is present and its cadence equals existing.schedule?.cadence, leave nextRunAt undefined so the stored next run is kept. Only recompute when the cadence actually changes, or when the report had no schedule before.

Thanks for the detailed report; here is what triage found.

In the PATCH handler, any request that includes a schedule recomputes nextRunAt from the current time via firstRunAt, even when the cadence is unchanged. Adding a recipient therefore restarts the weekly cadence from the edit date, which explains the move from Monday to Thursday. A maintainer flagged this when the PATCH handler was written: "resending a schedule should never move the run day." A draft PR (pr-42) proposes keeping the stored next run when the cadence is unchanged.

In short: in the PATCH handler, any request that includes a schedule recomputes nextRunAt from the current time via firstRunAt, even when the cadence is unchanged.
